title: orderflow-rs
description: A Rust pipeline for LOB microstructure research: multi-exchange ingestion, order-flow features, and a full simulation/backtest/reporting research engine.

live-websocket-connectors.title: Live WebSocket Connectors
live-websocket-connectors.description: Seven direct exchange WebSocket ingesters (Binance, Coinbase, Kraken, Gemini, OKX, Bybit, Bitstamp) stream L2/L3 book deltas and trades into a common event type.

rest-polling-sources.title: REST & Polling Sources
rest-polling-sources.description: Poll-based ingesters for Alpaca, Polygon, Tiingo, Finnhub, Yahoo Finance, and Binance's REST API pull quotes and bars for venues without a book WebSocket.

historical-replay-adapters.title: Historical Replay Adapters
historical-replay-adapters.description: File-replay parsers reconstruct order books from LOBSTER (NASDAQ ITCH), IEX TOPS/DEEP, and Dukascopy FX tick data, so the same pipeline runs on archived data.

data-quality-reconnect-handling.title: Data-Quality & Reconnect Handling
data-quality-reconnect-handling.description: Every ingester tags rows with imputed/gap/outlier flags and resets feature state on snapshot resync or disconnect, so reconnections don't silently corrupt statistics.

order-book-reconstruction-engine.title: Order Book Reconstruction Engine
order-book-reconstruction-engine.description: A BTreeMap-backed bid/ask ladder applies deltas and snapshot resets event-by-event, rejecting crossed books, locked down by property-based tests.

multi-level-ofi-features.title: Multi-Level OFI Features
multi-level-ofi-features.description: Computes order-flow imbalance across ten price levels plus depth imbalance, microprice deviation, queue imbalance, and spread at every tick.

trade-pressure-impact-metrics.title: Trade-Pressure & Impact Metrics
trade-pressure-impact-metrics.description: Derives trade intensity, price impact, level-drain, and weighted mid-slope from the trade tape to capture liquidity consumption.

lookahead-safe-return-labeling.title: Lookahead-Safe Return Labeling
lookahead-safe-return-labeling.description: A delay queue attaches realized forward returns and sign labels at 1s/5s/30s/300s horizons only once each horizon has actually elapsed.

synthetic-lob-simulator.title: Synthetic LOB Simulator
synthetic-lob-simulator.description: An agent-based flow generator drives a synthetic limit order book, used to confirm OFI_1 predicts synthetic price moves under known ground truth (IC 0.15-0.33).

87-indicator-technical-engine.title: 87-Indicator Technical Engine
87-indicator-technical-engine.description: Implements 87 classical and microstructure indicators (RSI, MACD, ADX, Supertrend, Hurst exponent, and more) across five categories.

spearman-ic-reporting.title: Spearman IC Reporting
spearman-ic-reporting.description: Computes rank information coefficients per indicator per return horizon, the engine behind the cross-asset study across 162 symbol-source combinations.

walk-forward-backtest-engine.title: Walk-Forward Backtest Engine
walk-forward-backtest-engine.description: An OLS-fit composite signal feeds a walk-forward, transaction-cost-aware backtest, which found OFI signals unprofitable net of fees and spread.

four-phase-research-narrative.title: Four-Phase Research Narrative
four-phase-research-narrative.description: The README documents an explicit P4-P7 progression, each closed out with a stated pass/partial/fail verdict.

full-latex-thesis.title: Full LaTeX Thesis
full-latex-thesis.description: A compiled thesis PDF, "Predictability of High-Frequency Limit Order Book Dynamics," documents the complete methodology and results.

cross-asset-ic-study-report.title: Cross-Asset IC Study Report
cross-asset-ic-study-report.description: A standalone report analyzes 87 indicators across 162 symbol-source combinations spanning FX, crypto, and mixed assets across 15 data providers.
